purpose: Judge the BETSE-order emulator (validation/betse/emulator via default_world_adapter.py, BETSE's F = 96485 and R = 8.314), extended with BETSE's plasma-membrane Ca-ATPase, on the plain-BETSE case parity-rung1-20261108-01/betse-reference/default-world-mammal-dense (default world, ion profile mammal: Na, K, Cl, Ca, P, M), and the emulator's CPU result against its L4 result. The emulator reproduces BETSE's own update order, so it must agree to roundoff; it attributes Cells-vs-BETSE differences and is not an engine model. Same tolerances as emulator-default-world-dense; fixed before the runs it judges.
notes: matched_constants_or_cpu_gpu: the emulator with BETSE's constants against BETSE, or one Cells result against another of the same case (CPU vs GPU). codata_constants is reported for reference only.
Relative errors divide by |BETSE value|; a zero reference value admits only exact agreement.
SIM starts from BETSE's init_final.npz unless the run record says sim_start = chained.
Observables whose own change over a phase does not exceed the tolerance are reported as flat (non-discriminating).
